sample_unit: eyes (ultrawide field fundus images from 76 patients)

links.outcome: Accuracy of general-purpose MLLMs on AMD detection and grading from fundus images
links.effect: Binary classification accuracy ranged from 0.301 (Claude 3.5 Sonnet) to 0.824 (ChatGPT-4o); severity grading accuracy at best 0.463 (Perplexity Sonar Large). Reliability judged insufficient for clinical application.
links.quote: In summary, while MLLMs show promise for automated AMD detection and grading from fundus images, their current reliability is insufficient for clinical application, highlighting the need for further model development and validation.

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates the diagnostic accuracy and clinical utility of commercial multimodal LLMs for detecting and grading age-related macular degeneration from retinal fundus images without testing specific deployment safeguards.
